It is already **April 18, 2026**, so for me in Quzhou the wheat is not just starting, it is already in the field from last autumn. So when I think about this year, I am really deciding how to finish this wheat crop, then how to turn the land quickly into summer maize after harvest.

I only finished primary school, so I do it the practical way. I look at what worked on my own land, and I watch what the steady farmers nearby do. My land is only 10.1 mu, not big, so I cannot throw money around, but with 8 people in the house I still need stable grain. I will keep the wheat-maize rotation. Wheat gives me a sure crop, and maize follows right after, same as around here. For wheat, I will not cut fertilizer too hard because if the leaves go pale in spring, yield drops fast and that hurts more than spending a bit extra. I have well water, so I plan for a few irrigations, but not too many because pumping costs money. After wheat harvest I will plant maize quickly, with simple rotary tillage and sow right away so I do not miss the moisture window. For maize I will use hybrid seed like most neighbors, put on a moderate fertilizer rate, and watch rain before deciding on extra irrigation. I am not chasing the very highest yield, I just want a decent, steady harvest without spending beyond what the family can carry.
